headline: Sensex and Nifty Fall for Sixth Week Amid Global Rate Hike Concerns
why: US Fed rate hike outlook remains a primary concern for investors
Weakness in IT and Tata Group stocks weighed on domestic sentiment
Rising US Treasury yields reached levels not seen since 2024
Global sell-offs in European automotive and telecommunications sectors impacted markets
whatHappening: Indian benchmark indices recorded their sixth consecutive week of losses
The Rupee recovered slightly due to RBI intervention and lower oil
Gold prices climbed to a one-week high as oil prices eased
Market focus shifts to potential AI slowdowns and upcoming Fed path
summary:
Indian indices closed lower for the sixth straight week amid global volatility.
Weakness in IT and Tata stocks offset gains in the currency market.
Investors are now focusing on US interest rate paths and AI performance.
